parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of container clusters.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The key of the condition that is used to query alert events on containers. Valid values:

*   **instanceId**: the ID of the asset
*   **appName**: the name of the application
*   **clusterId**: the ID of the cluster
*   **regionId**: the ID of the region
*   **nodeName**: the name of the node
*   **namespace**: the namespace
*   **clusterName**: the name of the cluster
*   **image**: the name of the image
*   **imageRepoName**: the name of the image repository
*   **imageRepoNamespace**: the namespace to which the image repository belongs
*   **imageRepoTag**: the tag that is added to the image
*   **imageDigest**: the digest of the image

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the condition that is used to query alert events on containers. If you specify multiple values, separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The ID of the request source. Set the value to **sas**.

parameters.name: MultiAccountActionType
parameters.description:
The type of the accounts that you want to query. Default value: **0**. Valid values:

*   **0**: the current account.
*   **1**: all accounts.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:

*   **containerId**: the ID of the container
*   **uuid**: the UUID of the asset

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-event-level-count --from sas --cluster-id c7e3c5b420a7947c29333031446880000 --container-ids xxxxxx30389a10c28f6d38f2398f0dcexxxxxxx922b9e8290dc7c3019d4a8,48b87f2c0662e334820f436cb9133f1ae4e053d39b6fad42xxxxxxxxxx --container-field-name clusterId --container-field-value c951761046a9c4afe92be0a7b5bexxxxx --target-type uuid --multi-account-action-type 0 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
